subject: POC charter & scoring playbook for StellarPay — next steps
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Liu <emma.liu@stellarpay.com>, Rahul Sen <rahul@stellarpay.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC charter & scoring playbook for StellarPay — next steps

Hi Emma / Rahul —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Per our conversation I put together the initial POC charter and a lightweight scoring playbook so we can align on acceptance criteria and the evaluation method (offline vs shadow). I attached a PDF charter and an evaluation_rubric.xlsx that maps metrics to business impact. High level summary below so we can move quickly: 

POC objective
- Validate 2 core flows: (1) transaction dispute triage and (2) merchant chargeback categorization. Goal: reduce manual triage time by 40% and increase correct triage routing to downstream ops by 25%.

Proposed evaluation approach (recommended hybrid)
- Week 1: Data collection & anonymization — StellarPay provides 2k representative queries per flow (POC dataset).
- Week 2: Offline scoring — run the model on the dataset to compute baseline metrics (intent accuracy, classification F1, hallucination flag rate).
- Week 3: Shadow run (1 week) — run Redwood in shadow mode against 5% of live traffic behind prod. No writes; telemetry only. Evaluate real-time latency, KB cache hit rates, and error/fallback frequency.
- Week 4: Review & decision — synthesize offline + shadow signals, run qualitative spot checks, present acceptance recommendation.

Scoring playbook (attached evaluation_rubric.xlsx) — we propose weighted metrics:
- Intent match (30%) — macro F1 on labeled intents
- Routing accuracy (25%) — downstream system acceptance rate
- Hallucination rate (15%) — proportion of outputs requiring human correction
- Latency SLO compliance (15%) — 95th percentile token latency < 350ms in shadow
- Cost per 1k tokens (10%) — estimate delta vs current baseline
- Business impact adjustment (5%) — manual weighting for high-impact cases

Success gates (pass/fail)
- Minimum pass: Intent match >= 78% and Hallucination rate <= 6% and 95p latency < 350ms in shadow.
- Stretch target: Intent match >= 85% and Hallucination <= 3%.

Ownership (who does what)
- Data & labeling: StellarPay (Emma / Rahul) — provide anonymized dataset and 200 labeled examples per flow for calibration.
- Infra & shadow: Ben Carter (Redwood) — VPC setup, routing, traffic sampling, and telemetry hooks.
- Customer success & ops: Marissa Cole (Redwood) — onboarding, runbook, weekly syncs.
- Commercial & signoffs: Lauren Bishop (Redwood) — SOW/contract coordination and procurement contacts.

Attachments: StellarPay_POC_Charter_v1.pdf (charter + timeline), evaluation_rubric.xlsx (scoring matrix + example calculations).

Immediate asks / next steps
- Emma: confirm dataset availability and whether sample anonymization can be delivered by end of Week 1.
- Rahul: flag any compliance or procurement constraints we should be aware of (e.g., mandatory on-prem for any production traffic).
- Ben / Marissa / Lauren: confirm infra readiness and who will be the primary Slack/channel contact.

If this looks good, I propose we lock the timeline in today and schedule the kick-off for MON Aug 24 (1-hour technical onboarding + data handoff).

Thanks —

--
Priyom Das
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
pri.yom@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Emma Liu <emma.liu@stellarpay.com>
To: Priyom Das <pri.yom@redwood.ai>, Rahul Sen <rahul@stellarpay.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC charter & scoring playbook for StellarPay — next steps

Thanks Priyom — this is helpful and much appreciated. Quick clarifications from our side: 

1) Data & anonymization: we can provide the 2k examples but need Redwood to confirm the exact PII fields we should mask on your side. We prefer tokenized hashes for card identifiers instead of truncation.

2) Shadow concerns: procurement is likely to push back on any live traffic routing that touches external providers. If shadow requires routing through Redwood cloud we may need a narrow VPC-only proof first. Can Ben confirm whether a VPC-only shadow is feasible?

3) Labeling: we can commit to 200 labeled examples per flow by Aug 21 if you provide a simple labeling template (CSV columns + example).

Also attaching a short procurement note we typically send to vendors (procurement_note.pdf) — it lists standard security requirements and a templated DPA.

Emma
Head of Product Ops, StellarPay

Attachment: procurement_note.pdf

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <pri.yom@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: RE: POC charter & scoring playbook for StellarPay — infra notes

Priyom / team — looping in infra notes and a proposed lightweight shadow configuration. Quoting Emma's point on VPC-only shadow: she wants sampling without traffic egress to public Redwood cloud. We can support this via Redwood Private (VPC) with telemetry shipping to their SIEM. Tradeoffs:

- VPC-only shadow: highest compliance, slightly higher setup time (estimated 3 business days for VPC peering + routing + telemetry). No payload leaves the customer VPC.
- Hosted shadow: fastest to run (1 business day), richer observability out of the box, but procurement may flag outbound egress.

Proposal: do offline scoring week first while we set up VPC peering in parallel. If procurement clears earlier we can flip shadow to hosted; otherwise we run shadow inside the VPC. That keeps momentum and reduces risk.

On scoring thresholds: I reviewed the attached evaluation_rubric.xlsx and made two practical changes:
1) Add an "Unresolved Handoff Rate" metric (weight 10%) — measures % of cases that still require full manual routing after model output.
2) Change latency SLO to 95p inference latency < 400ms for VPC shadow (network variance) but keep 350ms target for hosted shadow.

Ownership confirmation:
- I will own the VPC setup and sampling config (Ben).
- Marissa will coordinate labels and weekly review with StellarPay.
- Lauren will engage procurement and push the DPA template with their legal team.

I'll draft a short infra runbook and send before EOD; Priyom please confirm kickoff once Emma confirms data timeline.

Ben
Sr. Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Liu <emma.liu@stellarpay.com>, Rahul Sen <rahul@stellarpay.com>, procurement@stellarpay.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC charter & scoring playbook for StellarPay — next steps

Emma / Rahul — great, thanks for the quick responses and the procurement note. Confirming the plan: 

1) Data & labeling: StellarPay to deliver anonymized 2k examples + 200 labeled per flow by COB Aug 21. We'll provide a CSV template (format: case_id, raw_text, intent_label, ground_truth_routing) by EOD today.

2) Parallel workstreams:
   - Redwood will start offline runs as soon as dataset is available (Ben leads).
   - Redwood infra to begin VPC peering prep immediately; Ben to share runbook before EOD.
   - Marissa to schedule weekly 30-min syncs (Thursdays) and run initial qualitative spot checks alongside StellarPay SMEs.

3) Kickoff: technical onboarding scheduled for Mon Aug 24, 10:00am PT (60 min). Invite forthcoming.

4) Procurement & legal: Lauren will follow up with procurement@stellarpay.com and share the DPA + SOW draft by Aug 20. Please loop procurement contact when ready.

Acceptance criteria reminder: Intent match >= 78% AND Hallucination rate <= 6% AND 95p latency within target (see infra note for VPC-hosted variance). We will treat this as a pass/fail gate with a single week remediation window if we miss one metric.

If there are no objections I will mark the timeline on our side and circulate the kickoff calendar invite.

Thanks all — looking forward to getting started.

--
Priyom Das
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
